knowledge.content: 3 premium effects: Magnetic Depth (3D tilt gallery hover via CSS transforms), Kinetic Typography (hero text scroll response), Memory Fragments (scrolling afterimages with chromatic shift).
4 Industrial Noir WebGL effects: Charcoal Shader, Mica Reactive, Paper Parallax, Pigment Trail. Required standalone init script in index.html due to Vite caching issues.
Gallery requires artworks-taxonomy.json. DataCache must be ready before Gallery.js/Lightbox.js init — use fallback to default data if not ready. Fixed race condition Feb 14.
All large images compressed with custom sharp script. Keep originals in backup. Check for oversized images in /assets/ periodically.

SEO landing pages are standalone HTML files (not SPA routes). Include breadcrumb schema, FAQ schema, local business schema. Features: scroll-reveal IntersectionObserver, counter animation, masonry gallery, pricing cards, accordion FAQ.
